description.value: When a creature moves within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it. If that attack hits, you may also try to damage a second creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach: if the original attack roll would also have hit it, it takes damage equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice), of the same type as the original attack.
